name: @pa-platform/pi-pa
description: Pi runtime adapter for the PA platform

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-extension-sources.mjs && node scripts/bundle-extension-sources.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/validate-extension-sources.mjs && node scripts/bundle-extension-sources.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @pa-platform/pa-core build && tsx --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs" && PI_PA_PLUGIN_SELECTION='{"pi-vimmode":true,"proper-base":true}' node scripts/bundle-extension-sources.mjs && tsx --test "src/**/*.test.ts" && node scripts/bundle-extension-sources.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/validate-extension-sources.mjs && node scripts/bundle-extension-sources.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @pa-platform/pa-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
